title: Ind-smoothness is compatible with successive quotients
statement: Let R → Λ be a homomorphism of commutative rings, and let K ≤ I be ideals of R. If Λ/IΛ is a filtered colimit of smooth R/I-algebras [def-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-smooth-algebras], then (Λ/KΛ)/(I/K)(Λ/KΛ) is a filtered colimit of smooth (R/K)/(I/K)-algebras.

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, Proposition 07CM, induction on the nilpotence exponent

proof.text: Put L = K.map(algebraMap R Λ), J = I.map(algebraMap R Λ). Ideal.map_mono gives L ≤ J. Ideal.map_map and the definition of the quotient algebra map identify the ideal extended from I/K to Λ/L with J.map(Quotient.mk L).

Use DoubleQuot.quotQuotEquivQuotOfLE for the base and algebra, adjusting the algebra ideal with Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq. The resulting ring equivalences commute with the structure maps: use injectivity of the algebra equivalence and quotient induction twice; on representatives the square commutes definitionally.
Apply ind_smooth_of_ringEquiv to the base equivalence and the inverse of the compatible algebra equivalence, transporting the given ind-smooth presentation to the canonical successive quotient.

proof_origin.note: Second reader replaced the restatement hole with explicit quotient isomorphisms and a fully proved general scalar-transport theorem.
